thread:
sarah: Async check-in — quick status (what I did / blockers / today)
- Done: opened PR #412 to tighten burst window on edge policy and added unit tests.
- Blocker: staging showing ~10-20% 429s for long-sequence requests, can't reproduce locally. :thinking:
- Today: triage with @vikram, try a conservative rate-profile tweak, run the stress job and coordinate merge window.

vikram: I'll own the triage. My hunch is prefix-cache + continuous batching interaction under certain seq-length distributions. Spinning up a reproduce on the dedicated pool now. Pinging @tess for staging logs.

tess: Oncall: pulled staging logs — saw a token-queue spike at 03:02 UTC and a cluster of 401->retry cycles around the same time. Logs uploaded to /var/logs/edge/2026-03-17-03.tar.gz. Forwarding subset to #incidents. :mag:

sarah: thanks @tess. If auth retries are triggering backoff that could amplify queueing. @leo did any token rotation or auth caching change land overnight?

leo: No full token rotation. We did merge a tiny change to route-owner timeout last night (PR #409) which is in canary. Not obvious why 401s would spike but I'll correlate timestamps with the canary rollout. Also FYI I can flip route timeouts back if we confirm correlation.

ci-bot: Deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-17T03:00 UTC — 3/4 nodes succeeded, 1 node auto-rolled back due to healthcheck failure (code 502).

vikram: Repro steps I used: `ab -n 2000 -c 50 -p payload.json http://edge.local/v1/generate` — saw ~15% 429s. Next step: run with `--no-cache` and another run with `edge.batch.size=8` to see delta.

sarah: Plan: I'll stage merge of #412 (tighten burst) behind a feature flag and then roll back PR #409 from canary if metrics don't improve. Can we target a 30m quiet window for the change?

leo: Sounds good. I can flip the canary out and enable fallback config. We have a hotflag `edge.batch.size` and `edge.auth.cache_ttl` set in ops. If things degrade we can set `edge.batch.size=8` quickly.

tess: I'll watch the SLO dashboard and set an alert if 5m 429% > 3%. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/edge/429s?orgId=1

sarah: great. tagging folks for visibility: @vikram @tess @leo. Thx all — will post results here after the runs. :thumbsup:
